readings: Define each media type's rate as SUM(Bytes) divided by SUM(Milliseconds) over its tracks, grouped by media type name and joined to MediaType. Compute the simple (unweighted) average of these rates across all media types. Keep only the media types whose rate is above that average. In one unrounded row, return the average rate of those media types, their average track count, and their average of (rate minus the overall average).

Define each media type's rate as the average of the per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds over its tracks, grouped by media type name and joined to MediaType. Compute the simple (unweighted) average of these rates across all media types. Keep only the media types whose rate is above that average. In one unrounded row, return the average rate of those media types, their average track count, and their average of (rate minus the overall average).
queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS cnt
  FROM MediaType m
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r
)
SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate,
       AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_track_count,
       AVG(r.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_diff
FROM r, a
WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate;
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType m
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate,
       AVG(r.track_count) AS avg_track_count,
       AVG(r.rate - o.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_diff
FROM rates r, overall o
WHERE r.rate > o.avg_rate;
